title: Decomposition Ensembles for Bitcoin Price Forecasting: data, code and results
description:
Data, code and results supporting the manuscript "Decomposition Ensembles for Bitcoin Price Forecasting", submitted to PeerJ Computer Science.

The study forecasts the daily Bitcoin price by decomposing the series before learning rather than fitting a single model to the raw series. Daily OHLCV data covering 2014-09-17 to 2025-06-11 (3,921 records) is log-transformed, split chronologically, and decomposed with STL or robust STL at a period of 30 days. Separate deep learners (TCN, N-BEATS, GRU) are fitted to the trend, seasonal and remainder components and combined by a validation-guided rule (Auto selection, simple averaging, weighted averaging). Forecasts are evaluated at horizons of 1, 7, 14 and 28 days using RMSE, MAPE, R-squared and directional accuracy, averaged over ten random seeds on a 365-day test period, with Diebold-Mariano tests and the Model Confidence Set at alpha = 0.10.

This deposit contains the raw data, the experiment notebook with its cell outputs intact, the extracted result tables, and the figures and table of the manuscript.
